Snowflake's `COUNT_IF` likewise counts only TRUE and returns 0 — not NULL — when `cond` is NULL on all rows of a non-empty input (see the `zero_on_all_null` handling and comment in the DuckDB/Snowflake `COUNT_IF` tests).
